description_en: Queries the details of a business trip approval form
description_zh: 查询出差审批单详情信息
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen apply-query --type 1 --apply-id 123 --apply-show-id 201710111505000464651 --thirdpart-apply-id adczd --sub-corp-id btrip123 --x-acs-btrip-so-corp-token feth00jqwls --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ApplyQuery

parameters.description_en:
The submission type of the approval form. Valid values:
- 1: Submitted on behalf of another person.
- 2: Submitted by the applicant.

Note: When the approval form is submitted on behalf of another person, the submitter cannot place orders for themselves.
parameters.description_zh: 申请单提交类型 1代提交 2本人提交 注意：当申请单为代提交时，申请单提交人自己无法为自己下单
